description: This file defines the class Zend_Locale_Math_PhpMath, which provides mathematical operations that proxy to either PHP's built-in math functions or the bcmath extension, with fallback mechanisms and overflow detection. It is part of the Zend Framework's locale package, specifically for math operations.

classes.name: Zend_Locale_Math_PhpMath
classes.description: A utility class for performing math operations using PHP's built-in functions or bcmath extension, with overflow detection and fallback.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the use of bcmath functions and sets the class to use PHP's built-in math operators.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Performs addition with overflow detection, using either bcmath or PHP operators.

methods.name: Pow
methods.description: Calculates power, handling overflow and NaN cases.

methods.name: Div
methods.description: Performs division with overflow and division-by-zero checks.

methods.name: Sqrt
methods.description: Calculates square root, returns NULL if result is NaN.

methods.name: Mod
methods.description: Calculates modulus, returns NULL for invalid inputs.

methods.name: Comp
methods.description: Compares two numbers with optional scaling.

methods.name: Scale
methods.description: Sets the default scale and precision for calculations.
